name: Long Market
description: Historic public square with restaurants & souvenir shops amid period architecture & a fountain.

name: Golden Gate
description: Completed in 1614, this prominent Dutch Mannerist-style gate was rebuilt in 1957 due to WWII damage.

name: Bread Bridge - "Bridge of Love"
description: Canal crossing from the 14th century, with mill & church views & padlocks hung by local couples.

name: Neptune's Fountain
description: Landmark 17th-century bronze statue of the sea god surrounded by historic houses & cafes.

name: Muzeum Bursztynu. Oddział Muzeum Gdańska
description: Housed in a former prison, this cozy museum showcases amber artifacts, amber artwork & jail cells.

name: St. Mary's Church
description: Brick-built, Gothic Roman Catholic place of worship, completed in 1502, with a royal chapel.

name: Westerplatte
description: Former military area and site of first World War II invasion now marked by a grand stone monument.

name: Museum of Gdańsk - Main Town Hall
description: Gothic-Renaissance town hall with a 37-bell carillon, plus local history exhibition & events.

name: Statue of John III Sobieski
description: Bronze statue of the 17th-century Polish king John III Sobieski on horseback, set on a small square.

name: Monument to the Fallen Shipyard Workers of 1970
description: 3 towering steel crosses commemorating those workers who died in the 1970 anti-communist riots.

name: Highland Gate
description: This 1588 gate was the main entrance to the city & features symbols of Gdansk, Prussia & Poland.

name: Canis Restaurant | Restauracja Stare Miasto Gdańsk
description: Hip choice with a global menu highlighting creative meat, fish & veggie meals, plus desserts & wine.

name: Swojski Smak
description: Warm, brick-clad eatery dishing out hearty Polish comfort fare including pierogi, borscht & goulash.

name: Pomelo Gdańsk
description: Acclaimed restaurant known for its creative breakfast menu made from locally sourced ingredients.

name: Motlava Restaurant
description: Chic venue whipping up local staples such as meat plates, dumplings & desserts, plus wine.

name: Hora de España
description: Easygoing spot offering Spanish & Mediterranean dishes & tapas, plus homemade pasta & wine.

name: Chleb i Wino Stągiewna Gdańsk Restauracja
Fino
description: Upmarket restaurant featuring reimagined traditional dishes, creative plant-based options & wine.

name: Hilton Gdansk
description: Chic hotel featuring airy quarters, refined dining & a city-view cocktail bar, plus a spa & a gym.

name: Hotel Gdańsk Boutique
description: Upscale hotel in an 18th-century granary set on a marina offering dining, a craft brewery & a spa.

name: Hotel Number One
description: Modern rooms & stylish apartments in a relaxed riverside hotel with a spa & a restaurant.

name: Novotel Gdańsk Centrum
description: Streamlined rooms with free Wi-Fi, plus a refined restaurant/bar, a gym & kids' play areas.

name: Hotel Sadova
description: Contemporary property featuring a hip restaurant & a bar/lounge, plus an indoor pool & a gym.

name: Hotel Fama Residence
description: Straightforward rooms in a down-to-earth hotel featuring a lively bar & a restaurant.

name: Hotel Wolne Miasto
description: Relaxed hotel offering unassuming rooms & suites, plus 2 restaurants, a lobby bar & free Wi-Fi.

name: Hotel Arkon Park Business & Sport
description: Streamlined rooms in a casual hotel featuring a restaurant, a bar & a fitness center.

name: Oliwski Park
description: City park on 10 hectares with paths, French–style gardens & a greenhouse with exotic plants.

name: Park Jaśkowej Doliny
description: Forested trails lead to lookouts with sea views, plus an open-air stage for music performances.

name: Źródliska Nature Reserve in the Eve Valley
Trójmiejski Park Krajobrazowy
description: Postglacial landscape of wooded valleys & wetlands, with habitats for swans, owls & black storks.

name: President Ronald Reagan Park
description: Spacious park near the beach offering areas for walking, cycling & skating, plus playgrounds.

name: Park Oruński im. Emilii Hoene
description: Sprawling park with woods, meadows, fountains & lakes, plus walking paths & an open-air theater.

name: Brzeźnieński Park
description: Grand, 19th-century park with Prussian fortification remains, a 130m-long pier & a beach promenade.
